note: `create_failure_cleanup.owned_ptr` and `create_failure_cleanup.free_argument` are both semantic views over the vulnerable-original `flb_parser_create()` expression `p->decoders`: `owned_ptr` records the caller-owned decoder list still stored in the interim parser on the `ret == -1` path, while `free_argument` records that same `p->decoders` only when the create-time cleanup releases it (the fixed instrumentation emits NULL there because `flb_interim_parser_destroy(p)` leaves decoder ownership with the caller). `caller_cleanup_destroy.destroy_argument` is the exact vulnerable-original harness expression `list`, and `decoder_list_destroy_sink.list_argument` is the exact vulnerable-original callee parameter `list` at the ASan sink.
